description: This file contains unit tests for streaming strategy and stream function resolution in an embedded agent context, focusing on model provider configurations, API key resolution, and transport method routing.

methods.name: describeEmbeddedAgentStreamStrategy
methods.description: Determines how to describe or label the current stream strategy based on model configuration and context.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedAgentApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key for a provider, preferring a explicitly resolved key over stored keys.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedAgentStreamFn
methods.description: Resolves or constructs a stream function based on the current context and model parameters, routing through boundary-aware transports when needed.
